items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: So we introduced ourselves and I told him that I had played quite a lot in the Blue Room in act bands.

ctx.x: And a very fine person. Very nice person. Yeah. I saw him a couple of weeks ago. I just met him accidentally. I was playing at the hotel and I happened to come down the elevator after the job was over and he was on the elevator and he smiled and said, hello. I said, hello. I said, you look like a musician. He said, I am. He said, you do too. So we introduced ourselves and I told him that I had played quite a lot in the Blue Room in act bands. And he invited me to come in and listen to him. I told him, I said, I…
Now, what would make you say to him, you said, you look like a musician. He said, you do too.
